title: Netflix Q2 2026 Earnings: Revenue Slight Miss, Weak Q3 Outlook Send Shares Down 8%+
summary: Netflix Q2 revenue $12.6B grew 13% YoY but slightly missed consensus; Q3 revenue growth guided at 12% (deceleration). Shares tumbled 8%+ after-hours on growth slowdown concerns. Full-year 2026 guidance narrowed to $51-51.4B.
why: 流媒体龙头增长减速，Q3指引低于预期触发估值重估，高IV环境对科技股期权策略有警示意义，卖put时注意高溢价标的盈利风险

title: 港股午评：恒指跌1.98%失守25000点 科指跌4.04% 科网股、芯片股普跌
summary: 截至午间，恒生指数跌1.98%报24514点，恒生科技指数跌4.04%。美团跌超6%，快手、哔哩哔哩跌超5%；兆易创新跌超8%；药明合联跌超9%。昨夜美股芯片股大跌为主要拖累。
why: 港股全线重挫，持仓腾讯、阿里、美团等均受拖累；芯片板块尤为惨烈，关注是否为超卖机会或趋势性转弱

title: AI Memory Chip Stocks Tumble: SK Hynix -13%, SanDisk -12%, Micron -5% as CXMT IPO Looms
summary: SK Hynix fell 11.5% in Seoul and ~13% in US premarket; SanDisk (SNDK) sank 12%; Micron (MU) fell 5%+ as China's CXMT 295B-yuan STAR Market IPO spooks investors. Memory stocks have dropped 20%+ from recent highs, entering a technical bear market despite TSMC's strong results.
why: 存储芯片股进入技术性熊市，SK海力士(7709.HK)、美光(MU)直接持仓受损；CXMT上市后竞争格局压力是主要叙事，期权隐含波动率显著上升

title: Apple Intelligence Gets China Regulatory Approval with Alibaba Qwen & Baidu AI; BABA Shares Jump 7.9%
summary: Chinese regulators approved Apple Intelligence for launch in China via partnerships with Alibaba (Qwen AI) and Baidu. Qwen will power AI text/image features on iPhone, iPad, Mac and Vision Pro in China. Alibaba US ADRs surged as much as 7.9% on the news, with Hong Kong shares up 3.26%.
why: 通义千问嵌入苹果生态，Alibaba(9988.HK/BABA)获得亿级iPhone用户入口，是AI商业化最重磅催化；在港股大跌背景下阿里逆势走强，基本面分化明显

title: CXMT Opens Subscription for China's Largest 2026 IPO: 29.5B Yuan on STAR Market, H1 Net Profit Set to Top 50B Yuan
summary: ChangXin Memory Technologies (CXMT) opened STAR Market subscription July 16, targeting 29.5B yuan (~$4.3B) -- 2026's largest A-share IPO and STAR Market's second-biggest ever. Q1 revenue surged 700%+ YoY; H1 net profit projected >50B yuan. Priced at 8.66 yuan/share, global DRAM market share 7.67% (4th worldwide).
why: 中国本土DRAM龙头上市释放供给竞争信号，直接压制SK海力士(7709.HK)、美光(MU)估值；A股半导体板块短期受益，但全球存储行业供需结构重塑

title: Fed Chair Warsh Testifies: US CPI at 4.2%, Rates Held at 3.5%-3.75%, July Hike Probability ~25%
summary: Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh completed two days of Congressional testimony. CPI hit 4.2% YoY (highest since April 2023); Fed holds rates at 3.50%-3.75% for 4 consecutive meetings. CME FedWatch assigns ~25% probability to a July 29 rate hike. Warsh dropped traditional forward guidance in favor of data-dependence.
why: 高利率维持格局不变，七月加息风险仍在，全球估值压力延续；对sell put策略需留意高利率环境下delta对冲成本上升

title: TSMC Q2 2026: Record Revenue $40.2B (+33.7% YoY), AI/HPC Now 66% of Sales, N2 Ramp on Track
summary: TSMC Q2 revenue reached $40.2B (top of $39-40.2B guidance), up 33.7% YoY, driven by surging AI demand. HPC platform grew to 66% of revenue. N2 technology ramping; additional N3 capacity investments in Taiwan, Arizona, and Japan. Strong Q3 outlook issued.
why: 台积电强劲业绩验证AI芯片需求持续旺盛，但未能阻止存储股下跌说明资金正从存储切向先进制程；英伟达AI算力供应链逻辑获强化

title: 央行发布上半年金融数据：M2增8%，社融余额462万亿，企业贷款利率降至约3.0%
summary: 2026年上半年，人民币贷款增加10.72万亿元，债券融资增加8.51万亿元。M2余额356.71万亿元，同比增8%；社融规模余额462.06万亿元，增7.4%。新发放企业贷款加权平均利率约3.0%，同比低约20BP。
why: 信贷降速提质，流动性充裕但货币政策空间仍在；对持仓A股影响中性偏正，企业融资成本下行有利盈利改善预期

title: Circle (CRCL) Faces July 18 GENIUS Act Regulatory D-Day: Federal Agencies Must Issue Stablecoin Rules
summary: The GENIUS Act (signed July 18, 2025) gave federal regulators one year to finalize stablecoin licensing, reserve, custody, and AML rules -- deadline is July 18, 2026. Circle already received OCC approval for First National Digital Currency Bank N.A. CRCL stock faces near-term volatility on regulatory uncertainty.
why: USDC稳定币监管框架正式落地，Circle银行牌照确立合规地位；若规则偏宽松是行业系统性利好，若偏严格则CRCL短期承压；关注期权隐含波动率

title: 美团-W(3690.HK)股价连跌，外资大行逆势上调目标价：最高隐含40%潜在涨幅
summary: 美团在港股科技股普跌中跌幅居前（今日跌超6%）。财联社报道外资大行逆势上调美团明年目标价，最高潜在涨幅达40%。Keeta中东扩张持续（沙特、卡塔尔、科威特、阿联酋），巴西上线延期。
why: 美团估值已至阶段性低位，外资目标价上调提供逆向买入逻辑；Keeta海外营收增量有望缓解国内外卖竞争压力，是中长期逻辑支撑，卖put时需注意短期下行风险

title: Tesla Expands Robotaxi to Miami (3rd City); FSD v14.3.5 Rolls Out with Camera Preview Feature
summary: Tesla launched Robotaxi service in western Miami-Dade -- its third US city after Austin and San Francisco -- covering 10-14 square miles. FSD v14.3.5 (2026.20.6.6) added camera preview. NHTSA probe into FSD camera-only system in poor visibility remains open at engineering analysis stage.
why: Robotaxi商业化扩张节奏加快，但NHTSA调查进入最终阶段增加召回风险；对TSLA期权策略，Robotaxi扩张利多但监管负面事件可引发波动，注意事件风险

title: Palantir Wins US Army NGC2 Data Modernization Contract; Partners with Nvidia on AIP + Nemotron for Gov Workloads
summary: US Army chose Palantir Foundry as core cloud data layer for NGC2 modernization, building on existing $10B 10-year Enterprise Agreement. Palantir and Nvidia also announced collaboration deploying AIP+Foundry with Nvidia's Nemotron models in secure sovereign environments. Wedbush reaffirms $230 price target.
why: 政府AI合同+英伟达联手双催化，PLTR国防AI壁垒深化；Wedbush维持$230目标价，估值逻辑持续强化，对持仓/sell put策略是积极信号

title: 雷军宣布新一代小米SU7本月正式发布并启动大规模交付；YU7享7月购车限时优惠
summary: 雷军宣布新一代XIAOMI SU7将于7月内正式发布，随后启动大规模交付。小米汽车累计交付已超65.5万辆（上市24个月）。YU7 7月优惠：科技舒享套装6500元限时折扣，赠3000元车漆优惠券。
why: 小米汽车交付创新高是1810.HK估值修复的核心催化；新SU7上市刷新产品力，叠加YU7促销，有助于维持月交付量稳定增长，中长期持股逻辑得到强化

title: US Bitcoin ETFs End 10-Day Losing Streak with $221.7M Inflow; White House Plans High-Level CLARITY Act Meeting
summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs saw their largest daily haul in two months at $221.7M, ending a 10-day losing streak (worst June on record for these ETFs). Separately, White House is planning a high-level meeting with senators on CLARITY Act crypto market structure legislation to resolve remaining sticking points.
why: 比特币ETF资金回流信号正面，对Circle(CRCL)/加密板块情绪有支撑；CLARITY Act若通过将为加密资产分类和交易提供监管框架，是加密赛道系统性里程碑
